about: Under test (ct_engdet, seeded by gates/lib.js) the app's timed searches are node counts on a cleared table, so the same position gives the same line on a quiet machine and a busy one; a real device is unchanged. Graded by gate 166 whole (one real-device run, five quiet, five beside one spinning node process per core; about 10 minutes a try). The situations are the gate's own arms: the real device, the quiet machine and the busy machine. NOT COVERED: a real phone's search speed (the node budget is set for headless Chromium here); the computer's opponent with UCI_LimitStrength stays random by Stockfish's own design (its skill level draws a move with a time-seeded generator), so Play against a limited-strength bot is not made repeatable.

breaks.name: switch-ignored
breaks.why: the timed searches keep their clock under test, which is the defect the job fixes

breaks.name: table-not-cleared
breaks.why: the line search runs on whatever an earlier search left in the hash table

breaks.name: real-device-repeatable-too
breaks.why: the switch is always on, so a real device loses its normal search
